purpose: Uso real v3 ronda 19 (t1-c03 «no wey te pedi 5 nomas…», t3-c16 «no, en YouTube» with YouTube already playing, t3-c18 «esa no es la de programador wey, sigue en la estandar, cambiala» with Programador already on screen, t2-c04 «no espera se ve muy grande, regresala como estaba» read as a prohibition): the words a correction is said with, folded and without accents. interjections: a denial that only opens a correction, never a prohibition of what follows when what follows gives BAXY an order (semantic.grammar._opens_an_order, revisión adversarial 3 de la ronda 19: the denial is the default; an order is read by the existing request readers, an undo, or what was asked said back). cease_orders: the order heads the readers know (_COVERAGE_ACTION_HEAD) whose order is to do nothing («detente», «stop», «cancela eso», «olvídalo», «deja spotify abierto»): after an interjection they are the denial said again. refusals: the words that refuse the clause they are in («no en YouTube», «YouTube no», «nunca en YouTube»): a provider named in such a clause is never already held (semantic.dialogue.correction_already_holds). repeat_neutral: the words (articles, demonstratives, clitics) an answer may change and still be the last answer said again after a correction (llm._repeats_the_last_answer); a verb, a polarity or any other word changed is another answer. asked_reproaches: what the person says back about what they asked, at the head of a clause (semantic.dialogue.reproaches_what_was_asked); asked_reproach_negations: what follows a reproach that makes it a prohibition («te pedí que no lo abrieras»); asked_reproach_links: the words after which the request's own verb is reported («te pedí que abrieras…», «I asked you to open…»). A reproach of the state is said in clauses of its own (semantic.dialogue.state_reproach): state_denials («esa no es la de X») and state_claims («sigue en X», the state the person believes is still on) followed by state_skips and one word, then state_tags; the other clauses only lead (state_leads) or ask it changed (state_change_orders). another: a correction that asks for another thing never already holds. count_limiters: what may follow a count said back («te pedí 5 nomás»); count_extent: the words of a complaint about how much was told («no me sueltes la lista entera»). What BAXY says when a correction already holds is never a reply of these words: a held effect is said with its sentence (operation_floor heldFact, encargo TZ-HOLD), a held count is composed by the writer (alreadyHolds). Ronda 22 (premisa falsa: t4-c02 «te pedi 3 nomas y me tiraste una lista enorme» and t3-c17 «me tiraste como 7» after exactly the count asked, t4-c04 «te he dicho brillo no volumen» right after the brightness was set): count_extent also holds the past forms of handing over and their clitics («me tiraste»); count_given: the words after which a number is what the person says BAXY handed over («me tiraste como 7»), never what they ask; count_joins: what joins a complaint to a reproach of what was asked without a pause («…3 nomás y me tiraste…»). target_names: the words a person names a setting or a device part with, by the identity the operations observe (observed.setting, observed.provider, observed.appId, the operation's own name): a contrast whose wanted thing is what the last turn did, and whose refused thing it did not touch, already holds (semantic.dialogue.correction_already_holds, kind target).
